Name: Horny Barn
Author: RUBBERBARK
Description:
Sometimes I think it would be very fun to milk Alistar (you can milk those!), so I made this mod, although some animals and characters may not correspond well. This mod changes the appearance of barn animals: brown cow=Alistar (cows can be milked), white cow=Rengar (I can't think of a better solution, but I really like him ), goat=Ornn (they all have horns that may be a bit similar), ostrich=Renekton (I think they can all lay eggs), sheep=Volibear (his fur should be thick enough), pig=Nasus (someone reminded me that dogs with a keen sense of smell can also be used to find truffles, it's a great idea)Believe me, you will love the process of manual milking. Paired with the milking movements in the original game, it's a bit like masturbating them.

Firstly, you need to download the Content Patcher and Generic Mod Config Menu in order to use the mod properly.

After the update of this mod, an optional underwear version has been added, and the underwear version is enabled by default.
Please note that even the underwear version is not very safe！！

Usage: There are two config options here.
The first one is "Enable this mod", which can be turned off when you temporarily do not want to use this mod, so that the content of this mod will not appear in the game.
The second option is "Underwear Version" , if you want a nude version, turn off this option.

Wishing you a wonderful gaming experience.
